0022600225.text: The Warriors (8-3, eight straight wins, 8-2 in their last ten) visit the Rockets (8-3, 7-3 in their last ten) for the 12th game of Golden State's season, with the Warriors 2nd in the Pacific, 1.5 games back, and Houston 2nd in the Southwest, 1 game back. Golden State is without Jimmy Butler III (knee, surgery), Kristaps Porzingis (illness), Moses Moody (knee, surgery) and Will Richard (thumb), while Brandon Williams (hamstring) and Gary Payton II (knee inflammation) are day-to-day and game-time decisions, and Houston is without Clint Capela (ankle sprain) and Steven Adams (calf strain). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and in 2025-26 the Warriors lost 1-2, including a 117-116 loss in San Francisco on April 5, 2026.
